title: antennaria intermedia
intro: Antennaria intermedia, commonly known as Elbow Joint or Mountain Elbow, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Antennaria intermedia include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
